================================================================================
LoGOs spread in composite literals
================================================================================

package p

type Tri struct{ A, B, C int }
type Config struct{ Name string }

func spreads(base Tri, cfg Tri, named func(string) Config) {
	a := Tri{..base, A: 1}
	b := &Tri{B: 5, ..cfg}
	c := Config{..named("first")}
	d := Tri{A: 9, ..base}
	_, _, _, _ = a, b, c, d
}

================================================================================
LoGOs contextual words as names and labels
================================================================================

package p

func words() int {
	errdefer := 1
	yield := 2
	group := 3
	scope := 4
errdefer:
	for i := 0; i < 1; i++ {
		break errdefer
	}
yield:
	for i := 0; i < 1; i++ {
		break yield
	}
scope:
	for i := 0; i < 1; i++ {
		break scope
	}
group:
	for i := 0; i < 1; i++ {
		break group
	}
	return errdefer + yield + group + scope
}

================================================================================
LoGOs lambda parameter shapes
================================================================================

package p

func lambdas(x int) int {
	var g func() int = () => x
	h := () => 1
	add := (a, b) => a + b
	k := (a,) => a
	m := x => { return x }
	return g() + h() + add(1, 2) + k(3) + m(4)
}

================================================================================
LoGOs go group with block and plain call

package p

func groups(ctx int, group func(int)) {
	go group (ctx) {
		go group(1)
		go {
			group(2)
		}
	}
	go group(3)
}

================================================================================
LoGOs switch expression arms
================================================================================

package p

func load(s string, v int) (int, error) { return v, nil }

func arms(v int, in chan int, skip bool) {
	r := switch n := load("s", v)?; n { case 7 => 70; default => 1 }
	_ = r
	x := switch skip { case true => 3; default => <-in }
	_ = x
	y := switch v { case 1 => 1
	case 2 => 2
	default => 0 }
	_ = y
}

================================================================================
LoGOs option types and try
================================================================================

package p

func options(s string?, p *int, m map[string]int?) {
	a := s?.Len()
	b := s ?? "none"
	c, err := mayFail()?
	_ = a
	_ = b
	_ = c
	_ = err
	_ = p
	_ = m
}

func mayFail() (int, error) { return 1, nil }

================================================================================
LoGOs const views, unions, defaults, comptime
================================================================================

package p

type Reader interface {
	Read() (n int, err error)
	const Size() int
	Name string
	~int | ~string
}

type S struct : Reader {
	Port int = 8080
	Host string
}

type ViewSlice = const []int

func views(xs []int, v S) (const []int, error) {
	var out const []int = xs
	var total int
	const if v.Port == 8080 {
		total = 1
	} else const if v.Host == "x" {
		total = 2
	}
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
		_ = f.Name
	}
	const switch S {
	case Reader:
		total = 3
	case ~int:
		total = 4
	}
	return out, nil
}

================================================================================
LoGOs interpolation and tuples
================================================================================

package p

import "fmt"

func interp(name string, n int) string {
	return $"hello {name}, {n + 1} items ({fmt.Sprintf("%d", n)})"
}

func tuples() {
	pair := (1, "a")
	var t (int, string) = pair
	_, _ = pair, t
}

================================================================================

package p

func sum(vals ...int) int {
	return len(vals)
}

func call(args []int, rest []int) int {
	n := sum(..args)
	return sum(n, ..rest)
}

package p

func classify(x any) int {
	return switch x.(type) {
